definitions.explanation: The distance from the surface to the bottom, or the quality of being profound.

examples.japanese: この{池|いけ}の{深|ふか}さはどのくらいですか。
{傷|きず}の{深|ふか}さを{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: To check the depth of the wound.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{知識|ちしき}の{深|ふか}さに{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by the depth of his knowledge.

notes:
{深|ふか}さ is a noun meaning 'depth', derived from the adjective {深|ふか}い (deep) plus the nominalizing suffix さ.

WORD FORMATION:
{深|ふか}い (adjective: deep) + さ (suffix) → {深|ふか}さ (noun: depth)

This pattern (i-adjective stem + さ) creates abstract nouns:
- {高|たか}い → {高|たか}さ (height)
- {長|なが}い → {長|なが}さ (length)
- {広|ひろ}い → {広|ひろ}さ (width, spaciousness)
- {重|おも}い → {重|おも}さ (weight)

LITERAL USES (physical depth):
- {水|みず}の{深|ふか}さ: depth of water
- {傷|きず}の{深|ふか}さ: depth of a wound
- {雪|ゆき}の{深|ふか}さ: depth of snow

FIGURATIVE USES (abstract depth):
- {愛|あい}の{深|ふか}さ: depth of love
- {知識|ちしき}の{深|ふか}さ: depth of knowledge
- {悲|かな}しみの{深|ふか}さ: depth of sorrow
- {味|あじ}わいの{深|ふか}さ: depth of flavor

CONTRAST:
- {深|ふか}さ: depth (vertical distance down, or profundity)
- {奥行|おくゆ}き: depth (front-to-back distance)
